title: Fresnel reflection and Snell's law (2D)
description: An oblique plane wave on a dielectric half-space in a 2-D FDTD with Bloch-periodic sides. The reflection coefficient for s and p polarisation is the ratio of two runs (with and without the medium); at Brewster's angle p is not reflected; the transmitted angle comes from the phase gradient of the field inside the medium, against Snell's law.
